summary: Monroe County, PA lookout whose steel tower was moved to Dancing Ridge in 1935; a 2004 visit found only footings there, and no source describes Snow Hill today.

facts.design: Steel Blaw-Knox tower, as recorded for the Dancing Ridge site after the move
facts.status_note: Tower gone from Snow Hill; no source describes what remains at the site today

events.note: Steel tower moved from Snow Hill and renamed Dancing Ridge
Dancing Ridge register entry gives removal in 1975; a photo caption refers to tower remains in 2000
Visit report at Dancing Ridge: no tower standing, only concrete footings and possibly a platform

evidence.supports: first tower on a building, replaced by wooden then steel tower; steel tower moved 1935 and renamed Dancing Ridge
evidence.quote: The first tower located on a building was replaced by a wooden tower and then by a steel tower. The steel tower was moved in 1935 and renamed Dancing Ridge.

evidence.supports: no coordinates listed on the register page
steel Blaw-Knox tower constructed 1935, moved from Snow Hill, removed 1975
evidence.quote: This steel Blaw-Knox tower was constructed in 1935, was moved from Snow Hill, and removed in 1975.

evidence.supports: photo caption refers to tower remains in 2000
evidence.quote: Tower remains in 2000 (Photos courtesy of Pete Carron)

evidence.supports: 2004 visit: tower not found standing; only footings and possibly a platform remain
evidence.quote: Unfortunately, we did not find the tower standing. Only the concrete footings, and a platform that may have been at the base of the stairs, still exist.

evidence.supports: tower likely dismantled and removed from the site
evidence.quote: The tower itself was likely dismantled and removed completely from the site.

evidence.supports: survey marker recovered in destroyed condition June 17, 2004
evidence.quote: Recovered in Destroyed Condition on June 17, 2004

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Snow Hill entry says the steel tower was moved in 1935; the Dancing Ridge entry says it was constructed in 1935 and moved from Snow Hill. Both put the move in 1935, which the story follows.

notes_for_editor: Record coordinates (41.15843, -75.1924) are not confirmed by any source read: the Snow Hill register page says 'No coordinates are available'. The moved tower's entry gives 41.163703, -75.170456 for Dancing Ridge, a different point. Unresolved: the Dancing Ridge entry gives removal in 1975 but a photo caption refers to tower remains in 2000. The 'first tower located on a building' is undated and the building is unnamed. No staffing, fire or public-access evidence was found after one search and four page reads.
